annotations.title: Price drops and discounts of a brand

description: Get the recent price drops and discounted products of a brand, plus its price statistics. Use it when the user asks about deals, sales or prices of a brand in general (not of one product). `marca` is the brand name or slug (e.g. 'Bosch', 'bestway'). `bajadas` are real price drops recorded by SeeStocks in the last 30 days. `descuentos` are prices below the recommended retail price declared by the shop, which SeeStocks does not verify: present them as discounts on the declared price, not as price drops. Prices in euros.
name: ofertas_marca
